text:
mira: heads up — I sketched an operator approval matrix for runtime config changes that touch routing, quotas, and model fallback. goal: fewer accidental outages + clearer console UX for requesting approvals. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/1234

kevin: looked at the PR. overall +1. can we be explicit about the thresholds that force 2 approvers vs 1? right now 'high-impact' is vague.

josh: agree with kevin. from an oncall POV the obvious thresholds are percent-of-traffic, rate of change, and SAAS tenant count. propose: >5% traffic OR >50 tenants => 2 approvers incl SRE.

mira: good start. I have a draft matrix: low risk (UI-only label changes) = 0 approvals, medium (non-routing non-quota runtime flags) = owner approval, high (routing/quota/model fallback) = owner + SRE + Product OR an emergency exec override.

sam: need security review column for flags that change data routing or logging. even if it's just model fallback, if fallback sends data to a different region we need SRE+Security signoff.

kevin: UX question: how should the console surface this? two options: inline approval checkbox + auto-calculated risk score, or a modal that lists required approvers and links to a pre-generated request. I prefer inline score with a small tooltip.

mira: inline score seems less disruptive. score should be derived from: affected routes, percent traffic, quota buckets impacted, and whether sensitive data paths change. we can show required approvers and an estimated rollout window.

ops-bot: AUTO-CHECK: config schema validated, no merge conflicts, risk_score=0.62, affected_traffic_estimate=6.2%, requires_approvers=["SRE","Product"]. See checklist: https://internal.redwood/ops/config-approval-checklist

josh: ops-bot risk_score looks right. that 6.2% is why it's 2 approvers. we should also require a canary window: minimum 2 hours for small, 24 hours for high impact. automatic rollback if error rate increases by X.

kevin: define the telemetry gating signals for auto-rollback. proposed triggers: 1) p50 latency increase >30% 2) error-rate increase >1 percentage-point AND >3x baseline 3) quota burn > 150% predicted. any objections?

sam: add security alarm: unexpected egress to non-approved regions OR new external endpoint calls. those should soft-fail the rollout (pause + require manual).

mira: agreed. also adding a 'dry-run' mode that only routes a small sampled fraction (0.1% by default) to exercise the config without affecting production metrics. console should default to dry-run for all high-impact changes.

kevin: implementation note: backend needs a new field in the apply API: "approval_required": ["SRE","Product","Security"], "dry_run_fraction": "0.001", "telemetry_triggers": ["p50_latency","error_rate","quota_burn","egress_regions"]. we should version the API v2 to avoid breaking existing automation.

mira: yes v2. I added API draft to PR. also adding an approval audit log entry surface in console showing who approved, comments, and the calculated risk breakdown.

josh: for the rollback action, need to ensure we can restore previous effective config atomically. add an 'apply_token' that can be used to revert quickly. ops playbook should include the exact restore CLI command.

ops-bot: SUGGESTION: include a preflight validation run that simulates routing changes against a shadow traffic trace. can be toggled in UI.

kevin: one more wrinkle — scheduled rollouts. if someone schedules a high-impact change for off-hours it should still require the usual approvals but also notify oncall. add scheduled window metadata in approval flow.

mira: added scheduled_window to PR and a flag "notify_oncall": true for high-impact. final questions: are we comfortable with the percent thresholds? anyone want different cutoffs?

josh: +1 for current numbers, but let's add a telemetry-observed-adaptive cutoff: if our baseline traffic fluctuates a lot, ops-bot will recommend temporary raising/lowering the 5% threshold per-week.

sam: security ok with the flow, as long as the audit trail is tamper-evident and approvals are MFA-protected.

kevin: will iterate on console mockups next week. mira can you own product copy for the tooltip text?

mira: yep I'll write copy and add examples. I'll also add a short runbook for oncall in the PR. thanks all — will update the PR with the tweaks (dry-run default, scheduled_window, security column).

ops-bot: NOTE: created issue #789 in infra-telemetry to add p50/error_rate/quota_burn metrics to the approval gating index.

kevin: great. tagging this for a quick async thumbs-up: please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the current matrix after PR updates.

mira: thanks — closing loop once we have the thumbs-up and PR merged.
